title: Produce a migration bundle with central package management
goal: Build and execute a migration bundle with centrally managed application packages; inspect the temporary project and retain an EF10 workaround.

selectionNotes: Real Windows x64 framework-dependent SQLite migration bundles; matching Design/tool versions, inherited CPM and non-CPM control. SDK10.0.403 / EF10.0.13 versus SDK11 GA / EF11 GA. No self-contained, NativeAOT, multi-context, encrypted provider, other-platform or GA claim.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: EF Core 11 requires .NET 11. No older-runtime EF11 route is offered.

sdk.reason: Current SDK11 GA compiles the locked EF11 GA graph; verification covers only the recorded checks.

packageAssets: Audit SDK10.0.402/11 GA pins remain historical. Consumers use SDK10.0.403/C#14 and SDK11.0.100/C#15. EF10.0.13 selects net10.0, EF11 selects net11.0. Direct Data.Sqlite.Core10 selects net8.0; version11 selects net10.0. No EF11-on-net10 route. Exact restored graphs are locked separately.
